 Plan to Be Finalized With Q3 Earnings on the 28th
Total Expected to Reach 100 Trillion Won Including Buyback Cancellations
Largest on Record, Aimed at Lifting Share Price
 Finance | Published 2026.10.26. 17:35:46 | By Kim Yoon-soo sookim@sedaily.com | Summary | Save A A A SK hynix's Icheon campus. SK hynix SK hynix (000660.KS) is preparing to announce an additional shareholder return package worth 50 trillion to 60 trillion won ($35 billion to $42 billion), according to industry sources. Combined with the 40 trillion won buyback cancellation it recently completed, the chipmaker will carry out a record 100 trillion won in shareholder returns this year. With the company on track for record growth on the back of an artificial intelligence memory boom, it plans to use aggressive shareholder returns to lift its valuation to global top-tier levels.
 SK hynix will finalize this year's shareholder return plan through a board resolution on the 28th and disclose it the same day alongside third-quarter earnings, industry sources said on the 26th. Under a policy of allocating more than 50% of free cash flow to share buybacks, cancellations and dividends, the company is reviewing returns of 90 trillion to 100 trillion won. Brokerages estimate SK hynix's free cash flow this year at around 200 trillion won.
 After completing 40 trillion won in share buybacks and cancellations, the largest by a listed South Korean company, SK hynix is planning an additional 50 trillion to 60 trillion won in buybacks and special dividends. "With a large-scale buyback cancellation already carried out, special dividends will be the centerpiece," an industry official said. "But given demands from institutional and foreign investors, additional buybacks and cancellations are also partly under review."
 The shareholder return package SK hynix has planned for this year is seven times last year's and the largest on record. The company is expected to compete for the title of largest shareholder return by a South Korean company with Samsung Electronics, the industry leader that holds an edge in earnings and cash reserves. In August, Samsung Electronics signaled 90 trillion to 110 trillion won in shareholder returns this year, projecting it would be the largest among South Korean companies.
 SK hynix shares closed at 1.275 million won, far below their record closing high of 2.919 million won hit on June 22.
